description: Make a campaign take, every day, the companies a signal monitor finds (including a custom signal monitor, market.category "custom"). The person at each company is the jobTitle given (or the campaign's); a social monitor (engagement with posts) gives the people themselves, no jobTitle. Linking is free; each person is charged as any campaign person when they enter. From then on the campaign enrolls people from the signal on its own, every day. Takes the exact campaign id; it does not pick a campaign by itself.

campaignId.description: The campaign that will take the signal's companies every day.

confirmed.description: true only after the user agreed to the monthly cost a quote returned.

enroll.description: all: the companies already found enter too; future: only the next ones.

jobTitle.description: Who to reach at each company, e.g. "Sócio, Proprietário, Diretor".

monitorId.description: The signal (monitor) whose companies feed the campaign.

runBeforeActive.description: On a campaign that is not active: true runs the signal now (it spends and its companies wait for the activation), false runs it only once the campaign is activated. Only what the person chose in the quote's question.

name: feed_campaign_with_signal
title: Alimentar campanha com um sinal
